description: This Java source file defines the class 'DelegatingAuthenticationService', which implements an authentication service that delegates authentication requests to a remote identity server. It also implements health check registration for service readiness and liveness, and uses dependency injection for configuration and external services like DNS and connection factories.

classes.name: DelegatingAuthenticationService
classes.description: A Spring service that delegates authentication requests to an external authentication server and provides health check registration methods.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the specific configuration for the authentication server client.

methods.name: setDnsClient
methods.description: Injects an optional DNS client used for checking availability of the authentication service.

methods.name: setConnectionFactory
methods.description: Injects the connection factory used to connect to the authentication server.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Provides hook for registering liveness health checks; currently does not register any.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check to verify the availability of the authentication service via DNS or vert.x address resolver.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes the client connection to the authentication server during service startup.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Delegates external verification of a user to the authentication server.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Delegates plain text credential verification to the authentication server.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the service including host and port info.
